cards.title: I Was a Terrible Teen. Now My Son Is Turning Into One
cards.body: A parent reflects on karma as her adolescent son mirrors her own sullen, moody teenage behavior. The article explores how parents can handle parenting teenagers when they remember being difficult teens themselves.

cards.title: The Secret Behind Bedtime Stalling
cards.body: Bedtime stalling isn't simply opposition—it's a clumsy request for connection at the time children need it most. Learn how small changes can make bedtime calmer for everyone.

cards.title: Pizza, Pasta, Potatoes, Protein: Italian Children's Obesity Crisis
cards.body: Italian children are among the most overweight in Europe despite the Mediterranean diet being a health blueprint. The article examines how childhood nutrition patterns have changed in Italy.

cards.title: Sunscreen Doesn't Cause Cancer. Why Do Claims Spread?
cards.body: False claims about sunscreen causing cancer continue to circulate online each summer, misleading parents about child sun safety. The article debunks these dangerous myths.
